parts:
I managed to install a Shiny Server on Amazon AWS using Ubuntu 14.04. 

I have an app running locally without problems (Windows). My app reads a file with readRDS and perform serveral functions and plot using this dataframe. 

I have problems with encoding that I can´t solve. I tried using enc2utf8 (which solved some problems, but still persist). 

How can I set the Linux, R, and Shiny on my Ubuntu to work with the apps I create in my Windows Machine??

I save all files (server.R and ui.R) using UTF-8 encoding. 

Help is much appreciated.
